summary: Fundrise eREIT, LLC filed an 8-K regarding its entry into an Agreement of Merger and Plan of Reorganization and the completion of mergers with seven affiliated Fundrise eREIT entities, including Fundrise Development eREIT, LLC and Fundrise Equity REIT, LLC. On April 29, 2026, each Fundrise Merger Entity merged into Fundrise eREIT, with the registrant as the surviving entity. The Exchange Ratio was based on each entity's NAV per share at the April 28, 2026 Valuation Time. No cash price per share, premium, or buyout was specified; this is an internal reorganization. Shareholders received Fundrise eREIT shares of equal aggregate NAV. No board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Watch for ongoing integration and NAV performance post-merger.
